description: Concise whole-window detection of Team A movement-pattern transitions or new missile firing, using the user's annotation criteria.
changes: Detect only A0100/A0200 movement-pattern transitions or new missile-firing actions; remove generic importance and tactical-situation changes as standalone triggers.
Keep environment, state/action definitions and missile caveats from tactical_short_v1.
Replace centered 61-point hindsight timing with a variable past-only window.
Distinguish command switching and oscillation amplitude from a coherent change in actual movement, allowing command-to-motion lag.
Treat firing as an independent discrete event; preserve missing firing-command and uncertain launch-time caveats.
Prioritize before/after motion and firing evidence in reasons; update all shared questions, choices, and output instructions consistently.
Use generic oscillation examples without including annotated steps or expected answers in model inputs.
Condense system instructions from 1642 to 544 whitespace-delimited words by consolidating repeated criteria and caveats; leave output-contract detail in diagnostic.txt.
